wins: Completed initial host discovery across the /24 range with masscan and verified responsive targets quickly.
Documented service versions on the primary target allowing informed selection of post-exploitation techniques.
fails: Failed to achieve privilege escalation due to missing local exploits for the detected Ubuntu 20.04 kernel (5.4).
No persistence mechanism deployed; connection was lost after initial reconnaissance.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase executed well, but the run could not progress past post-exploitation due to lack of viable elevation paths.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Unable to pivot from user account to root because no working sudo misconfiguration or kernel exploit was found.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap scripts and capture banners

skill_cards.if_condition: When service enumeration yields versioned HTTP/SSL services
skill_cards.then_action: Run nikto and gobuster scans to map web paths and potential hidden resources

skill_cards.if_condition: When enumeration reveals Ubuntu 20.04 with sudo rights but no immediate exploits
skill_cards.then_action: Gather /etc/sudoers, custom scripts, and cron jobs to identify misconfigurations manually

memory_ops.reason: High payoff in reconnaissance phase by identifying open SSH and collecting credentials.

next_experiments.title: Experiment Elevation Breadth
next_experiments.description: Focus on Userland enumeration to find sudo misconfigurations, cron jobs, and writable binaries by scripting automated checks before attempting kernel exploits.

next_experiments.title: Experiment Persistence Pathing
next_experiments.description: Test multiple persistence strategies (systemd timers, user cron, tmux scripts) immediately after gaining user-level shell to maintain access.
